# Actual production CLI help must not start a service or resolve remote auth.
skygo server --help
stdout '--recover-stopped-artifact-readers'
stdout 'ALL[[:space:]]+historical[[:space:]]+producers'
stdout 'no[[:space:]]+surviving[[:space:]]+descriptor[[:space:]]+copy[[:space:]]+or[[:space:]]+use'
stdout 'same-domain[[:space:]]+kernel[[:space:]]+is[[:space:]]+qualified'
! stderr .

# Opt-in without artifacts refuses before Store/Local/listener acquisition.
# Both boolean spellings must reach the real server validator, not nil startup.
! skygo server --data-dir unopened --listen 127.0.0.1:0 --recover-stopped-artifact-readers
stderr '^stopped artifact reader recovery requires artifacts\n$'
! stdout .
! exists unopened
! skygo server --data-dir unopened --listen invalid --recover-stopped-artifact-readers=true
stderr '^stopped artifact reader recovery requires artifacts\n$'
! stdout .
! exists unopened

# Default and explicit false preserve ordinary listener validation. No service
# can bind this invalid address, and neither path may create durable state.
! skygo server --data-dir default-state --listen invalid
stderr '^listen address:'
! stdout .
! exists default-state
! skygo server --data-dir false-state --listen invalid --recover-stopped-artifact-readers=false
stderr '^listen address:'
! stdout .
! exists false-state

# An invalid boolean or a positional argument never starts a server.
! skygo server --data-dir grammar-state --recover-stopped-artifact-readers=maybe
stderr 'invalid argument.*maybe.*recover-stopped-artifact-readers'
! exists grammar-state
! skygo server unexpected --data-dir grammar-state --recover-stopped-artifact-readers
stderr 'unknown command|accepts 0 arg'
! exists grammar-state
